title: Citadel of Faith
textType: Interpretation and guidance by the Guardian of the Bahá’í Faith
author: shoghi-effendi
attributionNote: Citadel of Faith, by Shoghi Effendi: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its Shoghi Effendi shelf.
description: A collection of messages from Shoghi Effendi to the Bahá’ís of the United States, written between 1947 and 1957. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (Shoghi Effendi).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
